title: Diving Figure
description: A heavy woman with light skin and purple patterned clothes stands barefoot on the edge of a diving board above dark water. Her hands reach forward and her face looks down toward her large black shadow that spreads across the glowing pond below.
prompt: a heavy woman with light skin wearing purple patterned clothes and a head covering stands barefoot on a wooden diving board above dark water at night. she leans forward with both hands reaching down and her face looks toward the water. her large black shadow spreads across the glowing pond surface below. twisted tree branches frame the scene. bright green and pink aurora lights fill the starry sky. glowing birds and flowers appear around the water and trees. paint marks and runes stay as paint on the image.
